items.title: Eddie Morris Interview, 1958-12-21
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Yeah, it looks like Shatz. Shatz is there too. [INTERVIEWEE] He was there. He did.

ctx.x: Oh, we had a wonderful band there. Woo! People used to come from everywhere just to hear that band.
Yeah, it looks like Shatz. Shatz is there too.
